name: Make 10 and 20
summary: Tile shedding game where players must form same-color sets summing to 10 or 20 to empty their hand.
rules_text: Mix 110 numbered color tiles face down. Each player draws 15 as a hidden hand; the rest is the Dum-Mee draw pile. On your turn you have up to one minute. To enter play you must Register a color: play 3 tiles of the same color (30 red, 30 blue, 30 green, 20 black) that sum to 10, or 3-4 tiles summing to 20, and announce that color's Tree. Black tiles are jokers before registration but become fixed color after. You may register multiple colors but never a color already registered by anyone. Once you have registered at least one color, you may add to any registered Tree on the table by laying tiles that with the existing Tree tiles make new 3-tile sums of 10 or 20. First addition to a Tree must be at an end. Black tiles may be added to any Tree. You may make multiple additions per turn. If you cannot register or add, draw one tile from Dum-Mee and turn ends. First to use all hand tiles wins; if Dum-Mee empties, fewest tiles left wins.
rating_reason: Numeric tile melding to sum 10/20, turn-based arithmetic.
reasons: scope: spatial_board: out of scope by decision: the game depends on a spatial board (a grid, map, movement or adjacency)
